name: Mixed Fruit Jam
ingredients_raw: Sugar, Mixed fruit pulp blend-46% (Red papaya concentrate, guava puree, banana puree, apple juice concentrate, mango concentrate, pineapple juice concentrate, orange juice Concentrate, grape juice concentrate) Thickener - INS440, Acidity Regulator Flavour, Preservative-INS211 & Food Colour - INS122. CONTAINS PERMITTED SYNTHETIC FOOD COLOUR. ADDED NATURAL AND NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCE. CONTAINS PERMITTED CLASS II PRESERVATIVE
